<script src="/js/i18n.js"></script>
<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';
  var d=document, $=function(s,r){return (r||d).querySelector(s);}, $$=function(s,r){return [].slice.call((r||d).querySelectorAll(s));};
  var reduce=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  d.documentElement.classList.add('js');

  var hdr=$('#siteHeader'), stick=$('#stick'), hero=$('#top'), prog=$('#scrollProgress');
  function onScroll(){ var y=window.scrollY||0; hdr.classList.toggle('sc', y>10); if(stick) stick.classList.toggle('on', y>(hero?hero.offsetHeight:600));
    if(prog){ var h=d.documentElement.scrollHeight-innerHeight; prog.style.width=(h>0?Math.min(100,(y/h)*100):0)+'%'; } }
  addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, {passive:true}); addEventListener('resize', onScroll); onScroll();

  var navLinks=$$('#navigation a[href^="#"]');
  var secMap=navLinks.map(function(a){ var id=a.getAttribute('href').slice(1); return {a:a, el:d.getElementById(id)}; }).filter(function(x){return x.el;});
  if('IntersectionObserver' in window && secMap.length){
    var secIo=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){ es.forEach(function(e){ if(e.isIntersecting){ var id=e.target.id;
      navLinks.forEach(function(a){ a.classList.toggle('active', a.getAttribute('href')==='#'+id); }); } }); },{rootMargin:'-45% 0px -50% 0px',threshold:0});
    secMap.forEach(function(x){ secIo.observe(x.el); });
  }

  var menu=$('.menu-toggle'), nav=$('#navigation');
  function closeMenu(){ menu.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false'); menu.setAttribute('aria-label',SMLang.t('Åpne meny')); menu.textContent='☰'; nav.classList.remove('open'); }
  menu.addEventListener('click', function(){ var open=menu.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true'; menu.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open)); menu.setAttribute('aria-label',SMLang.t(open?'Lukk meny':'Åpne meny')); menu.textContent=open?'✕':'☰'; nav.classList.toggle('open',open); });
  $$('a',nav).forEach(function(a){ a.addEventListener('click', closeMenu); });
  d.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key==='Escape' && menu.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true'){ closeMenu(); menu.focus(); } });

  if('IntersectionObserver' in window && !reduce){
    var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){ es.forEach(function(e){ if(e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); } }); },{threshold:.12, rootMargin:'0px 0px -6% 0px'});
    $$('.rv').forEach(function(el){ io.observe(el); });
  } else { $$('.rv').forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add('in'); }); }

  // Before / after — range + buttons, keyboard-friendly, plus a one-time intro sweep
  var range=$('#reveal'), scene=$('#comparison'), btns=$$('[data-reveal]');
  if(range && scene){
    function update(){
      var v=Number(range.value);
      scene.style.setProperty('--cut', v+'%');
      range.setAttribute('aria-valuetext', v+' prosent standardoppsett, '+(100-v)+' prosent ny retning');
      btns.forEach(function(b){ b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(Number(b.dataset.reveal)===v)); });
    }
    range.addEventListener('input', update);
    btns.forEach(function(b){ b.addEventListener('click', function(){ range.value=b.dataset.reveal; update(); }); });
    update();
    if(!reduce){
      var touched=false; range.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(){ touched=true; }, {once:true});
      var t0=null, from=48, to=22, dur=1400;
      function sweep(ts){ if(touched) return; if(!t0) t0=ts; var k=Math.min(1,(ts-t0)/dur); var e=1-Math.pow(1-k,3);
        range.value=Math.round(from+(to-from)*e); update(); if(k<1) requestAnimationFrame(sweep); }
      setTimeout(function(){ requestAnimationFrame(sweep); }, 900);
    }
  }

  var drifters=$$('[data-drift]');
  if(drifters.length && !reduce){
    var ticking=false;
    function drift(){ ticking=false; var vh=innerHeight, mid=vh/2;
      drifters.forEach(function(el){ var r=el.getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.bottom<-200 || r.top>vh+200) return;
        var c=r.top+r.height/2, off=(c-mid)*Number(el.dataset.drift); el.style.setProperty('--drift', off.toFixed(1)+'px'); }); }
    function req(){ if(!ticking){ ticking=true; requestAnimationFrame(drift); } }
    addEventListener('scroll', req, {passive:true}); addEventListener('resize', req); req();
  }

  (function(){
    var rV=$('#rV'), rC=$('#rC'), rK=$('#rK'); if(!rV||!rC||!rK) return;
    function loc(){ return (window.SM_LANG==='en') ? 'en-GB' : 'nb-NO'; }
    function nf(n){ return Math.round(n).toLocaleString(loc()); }
    function kr(n){ return window.SM_LANG==='en' ? 'NOK '+nf(n) : nf(n)+' kr'; }
    function setp(el){ var mn=+el.min, mx=+el.max, v=+el.value; el.style.setProperty('--p', ((v-mn)/(mx-mn)*100)+'%'); }
    function calc(){
      var v=+rV.value, c=+rC.value, k=+rK.value;
      $('#oV').textContent=nf(v);
      $('#oC').textContent=c.toLocaleString(loc(),{minimumFractionDigits:1,maximumFractionDigits:1})+' %';
      $('#oK').textContent=kr(k);
      var extra=v*0.01;
      $('#oRes').textContent='+ '+(extra>=1?nf(extra):extra.toFixed(1))+' '+SMLang.t('kunder / mnd');
      $('#oVal').textContent=window.SM_LANG==='en'
        ? '≈ '+kr(extra*k)+' '+SMLang.t('kr ekstra omsetning per måned')
        : '≈ '+nf(extra*k)+' '+SMLang.t('kr ekstra omsetning per måned');
      [rV,rC,rK].forEach(setp);
    }
    [rV,rC,rK].forEach(function(r){ r.addEventListener('input', calc); });
    document.addEventListener('sm:lang', calc);
    calc();
  })();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
